name: Log-In Logistica Intermodal S.A.
summary: Log-in Logística Intermodal S.A. plans, manages, and operates logistics solutions through an intermodal network in Brazil and the Mercosur. The company has an integrated network that facilitates port movement and door to door transportation; and provides logistical planning, coasting trade, and port and intermodal terminal services. As of February 05, 2021, the company owned a fleet of six container ships with a capacity of 15,500 TEUs. It also manages and operates the Vila Velha Port Terminal located in the Port of Vitória, Espírito Santo; and two container terminals, including one in Itajaí, Santa Catarina and the other in Guarujá, São Paulo. The company was incorporated in 1973 and is headquartered in Rio de Janeiro, Brazil.
